Systemic finding: the Army reissued the AFARS for the RFO (Part 5104 revised 30 Jun 2026; Parts 5109 and 5137 revised 4 Jun 2026; combined PDF on army.mil). acquisition.gov still serves the 11 Jul 2025 AFARS. Two drafts (Q0035, Q0145) cited the old numbering and Q0145 asserted 'the RFO does not change AFARS numbering'. Recommend adding AFARS 5104.802(f) -> 5104.101(a)/PGI 5104.101 and AFARS 5137.590-x -> 5137.890-x to src/data/regulations.json crosswalk, and re-checking every other AFARS cite in the bank against the June 2026 PDF.

Second systemic finding: FPDS.gov was retired on 24 Feb 2026 and contract award data now lives in SAM.gov; three drafts (Q0035, Q0084, Q0278) still named FPDS as a live system. Other batches should be grepped for 'FPDS'.

Two substantive legal errors were fixed: Q0220's preaward GAO-protest override (no 'best interests' ground; HCA nondelegable; award-within-30-days finding) and Q0039's suspension-period rule (18 months is the AAG-extended cap, not a consequence of legal proceedings). One misleading option was removed from Q0139 (a UCA does not cure unavailable funds).
Invented role name 'Chief, Policy and Compliance' appeared in Q0145 and Q0278; replaced with the brief's role descriptor 'Chief, C&P'. No local thresholds, names or emails were found.
